the EGIT mechanisms in SMEs should focus on: (i) the definition of an EGIT strategy; (ii) the creation and maintenance of a business/IT alignment; (iii) the creation and use of a business/ IT portfolio; (iv) the definition and maintenance of an IT governance structure; (v) the use of an IT governance process; and (vi) the use of a relational governance mechanism.

the baseline of mechanisms for EGIT in SMEs are: (1) a formal structure for IT decision-making, (2) an adequate communication and coordination among IT and business units, (3) a clear IT strategy aligned with the business strategy, (4) an adequate IT architecture, (5) an adequate IT portfolio management, (6) an appropriate IT investment evaluation and prioritization and (7) a proper IT risk management.
